name: bmv-torneios-functions
description: Cloud Functions do Motor de Torneios do Buraco Master VIP (OS 02 secao 20). As regras NAO vivem aqui: elas vem do dominio Dart compilado para JS (functions/lib/domain_bundle.js).

scripts.build:domain: cd .. && dart compile js -O2 -o functions/lib/domain_bundle.js app/lib/torneios/js_bridge.dart
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
scripts.deploy: npm run build:domain && npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
